name: Self Destruct
text:
Trigger Your reanimated clockwork companion is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You're within 60 feet of your reanimated clockwork companion.

---
You've installed a self-destruct device within your construct companion, which you can trigger with a special device from up to 60 feet away. When you activate the device, your reanimated construct companion explodes, dealing 2d6 fire damage per level ((2*@actor.leveld6) fire) to all creatures in a 30-foot radius. Creatures caught in the blast can attempt a Reflex save save, with a DC equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC.
